scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.format:check: node frontend/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check README.md docs render.yaml package.json package-lock.json .prettierrc.json frontend/README.md backend/README.md
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix backend run format && node frontend/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write README.md docs render.yaml package.json package-lock.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend && npm run format:check
